title: Support-Set Target Leakage in Relational Foundation Models during In-Context Learning: Impact, Detection, and Mitigation
abstract: arXiv:2609.36384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Relational in-context learning (ICL) conditions predictions on the labeled support examples and their linked tables, creating a failure mode when the support set contains target-derived features that are unavailable for the query. We formulate this problem as support-set target leakage, distinct from leakage during dataset construction, temporal splitting, or representation learning. Here, the target-derived (leaker) columns are present only in the labeled support set during relational in-context inference, while queries remain clean. We construct 14 synthetic leaker types, corresponding to 20 columns, spanning proxies with different noise levels, coverage, modalities, semantic transparency, and relational distances. We evaluate a frozen relational encoder with an ICL head on held-out RelBench databases and use Integrated Gradients (IG) to rank and remove suspicious columns. Our results show that the effect of support-set leakage varies

translated_title: 关系基础模型上下文学习中的支持集目标泄漏：影响、检测与缓解
translated_abstract: 关系式上下文学习（ICL）将预测建立在带标签的支持样本及其关联的表之上，当支持集中包含查询样本无法获取的目标衍生特征时，会产生一种新的失败模式。我们将该问题形式化为“支持集目标泄漏”，以区别于数据集构建、时间划分或表示学习过程中出现的泄漏。在这种情形下，目标衍生（泄漏）列仅存在于关系式上下文推断阶段的带标签支持集中，而查询样本保持干净。我们构建了14种合成泄漏类型，对应20个列，涵盖具有不同噪声水平、覆盖率、模态、语义透明度和关系距离的各类代理特征。我们在留出的RelBench数据库上评估带有ICL头的冻结关系编码器，并使用积分梯度（IG）方法对可疑列进行排序与移除。我们的结果表明，支持集泄漏的影响随（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文首次形式化了关系基础模型上下文学习中“支持集目标泄漏”这一失败模式（即支持集含查询不可得的目标衍生列导致性能虚高），构建了14种合成泄漏类型，并提出基于积分梯度的检测与移除方法来缓解该问题。
en_tdlr: This paper formalizes "support-set target leakage" in relational foundation models during in-context learning—where the support set contains target-derived columns unavailable to queries—constructs 14 synthetic leaker types, and proposes an Integrated Gradients-based approach to detect and mitigate this leakage.
